title: Haunted Record Press
economy: Not required. Attempts는 mission-local 기회 수이며 화폐가 아니다.
one_line: 유령의 목표 파형을 읽고 회전하는 레코드의 구간별 홈 깊이와 흔들림을 직접 새겨 잃어버린 노래를 복원하는 모바일 정밀 제작 퍼즐.
core_loop: Mission Brief → 각 segment에서 Preview → Pressure 선택 → start-to-end Carve → Replay/Review → score 70 이상이면 Accept, 아니면 남은 attempt로 Correct → 모든 segment를 통과하면 Full Playback과 Result → 다음 record 해금 또는 Retry.
mvp_scope: 10 authored restoration missions, 각 3–6 ordered segments. Clean Melody/Wavering Voice/Pressure Phrase/Tempo Phrase/Composite Record 5 content classes. 32-sample normalized trace judging, pressure 1–3, target duration 1.5–5.0s, attempts 3/segment, pass70/perfect90, Review/Correction, Full Playback, 1–3 stars, linear unlock, pause/retry/best score 저장을 포함한다.

target.each_segment: 32 target lateral offsets v[-1,1], target_pressure 1..3, target_duration_seconds, start/end markers

hazards.static: none; challenge is precision, pressure and tempo, not random failure

mission.pause: freezes playback, timers and carving; if paused during Carving, current carve is cancelled without attempt cost and returns Carve Ready
mission.retry: resets all segment traces/scores/attempts and mission progress
mission.rating: final_score=rounded mean of accepted segment scores; 1 star=success, 2 stars>=80, 3 stars>=90

scoring.shape_error: mean absolute difference of 32 player_v vs target_v, clamped 0..1

attempts.failure: if score<70 and attempts_left=0, mission fails immediately after Review
attempts.correction: Review retry allowed only if attempts_left>0; clears trace but preserves target
attempts.consumption: a valid completed carve consumes one attempt immediately

measurement.speed: elapsed carve time in seconds measured from valid start touch to valid end release
measurement.pressure: integer 1..3 fixed for one carve attempt
measurement.sampling: while dragging, resample pointer path to exactly 32 evenly spaced u samples by linear interpolation
measurement.segment_space: u=0 at authored arc start, u=1 at arc end; lateral offset v is signed normalized distance perpendicular to authored centerline; segment half-width=1
measurement.record_rotation: visual rotation only; judging coordinates use normalized local segment space, not screen/world rotation

valid_carve.end: release within end zone radius 0.12 and at least 80% of authored arc traversed
valid_carve.start: pointer down within logical start zone radius 0.12 segment-width units
valid_carve.invalid: invalid carve consumes no attempt and returns Carve Ready
valid_carve.progress: u must never decrease by more than 0.08 between raw samples

not_in_mvp: More than one stylus path at once
known_risks: Finger occlusion can hide the target trace
Precision scoring may feel harsher than the visual suggests
Synthetic comparison audio may not match perceived score without careful sound design
Long wavering traces may amplify touch jitter
Ten missions need authored target traces that are distinct without introducing undeclared mechanics
progression: 10개 mission은 선형 해금된다. Mission 1만 최초 해금. 성공하면 다음 mission을 해금하며 각 mission의 best stars(1–3)와 best score를 저장한다. 별은 물리/판정 능력을 강화하지 않으며 재도전 동기와 완료 표시만 제공한다.
screen_flow: Record Shelf → Mission Brief → Gameplay Inspect → Carve Ready → Carving → Review. Pass+Accept는 다음 segment Inspect, failed score+attempts는 Correct→Carve Ready, score<70+attempts0은 failure Result. 마지막 Accept→Full Playback→success Result. Success Next는 다음 Mission Brief, Retry는 같은 mission 초기화, Shelf는 선택 화면 복귀. Pause는 Gameplay/Full Playback에서 현재 의미를 보존하며 Carving 중에는 미완성 carve만 무비용 취소한다.

state_model.enter: mission start or prior segment accepted
Inspect continue or correction or paused-carve cancel

state_model.failure_cancel: invalid release clears trace no cost; pause cancels no cost

state_model.exit: accept/retry or automatic fail when score<70 and attempts=0
state_model.next: Inspect next segment, Carve Ready, or Result

state_model.enter: Full Playback complete/continue or mission failure

classes.difference: 3–4 segments; straight/low-amplitude target traces; pressure target fixed per segment; base interactions
target v alternates sign frequently; same states/interactions, higher shape precision demand
segments vary target_pressure 1/2/3; forces pressure choice before carve; no new state
target durations vary 1.5–5.0s; tempo error materially affects score; no new state
5–6 segments combining wavering shape, pressure and tempo targets; Full Playback emphasizes reconstructed whole song

content_model.coverage: all later missions reuse the same state graph and interactions; only target data and combinations change
content_model.topology: each mission is an ordered linear list of 3–6 segments; segment i+1 cannot open until i is accepted; no branching
variation_axes: pass margin via authored target complexity

player_fantasy: 플레이어는 폐점 후 음반 공장의 마지막 커팅 기사다. 유령이 남긴 허밍을 시각적 파형과 촉각적 조각 규칙으로 번역해 망가진 노래를 다시 들리게 만드는 장인 숙련감과 복원 완료의 정서적 보상을 느낀다.
test_scenarios: Valid carve with shape_error0.10 pressure_error0 tempo_error0.10 yields score 92 and can Accept.
Valid carve consumes exactly one attempt; invalid start/end/progress consumes zero.
Three valid sub-70 attempts reduce attempts 3→2→1→0 and third Review reaches failure Result.
Pause during Carving cancels current uncommitted trace without attempt cost and returns Carve Ready.
Pressure target 3 with player pressure1 produces pressure_error1 and lowers score by exactly 20 weighted points before other errors.
All five content classes run through the same state graph without requiring a new interaction.
Last accepted segment enters Full Playback then success Result and unlocks exactly next mission.
Retry resets all traces, scores and attempts while preserving meta unlock/best records.
design_markdown:
# Playable Game Design Spec v0.1 — Haunted Record Press

## 1. Product Definition
유령의 목표 파형을 읽고 회전하는 레코드의 구간별 홈 깊이와 흔들림을 직접 새겨 잃어버린 노래를 복원하는 portrait mobile 정밀 제작 퍼즐. Mission 3–6분. 목표 감각은 듣고 본 패턴을 손의 궤적·압력·속도로 번역하는 장인 숙련감이다. Non-goals: 실제 오디오 분석, 마이크 입력, 자유곡 import, 화폐/상점, 온라인 경쟁.

## 2. Player Fantasy
플레이어는 폐점 후 음반 공장의 마지막 커팅 기사다. 유령이 남긴 허밍을 시각적 파형과 촉각적 조각 규칙으로 번역해 망가진 노래를 다시 들리게 만드는 숙련과 복원 완료의 정서적 보상을 느낀다.

## 3. Core Player Verbs
Preview는 현재 target phrase를 듣고 본다. Set Pressure는 1/2/3 깊이를 선택한다. Carve는 active arc start에서 end까지 한 손가락으로 홈을 긋는다. Replay는 target/player 결과를 비교한다. Correct는 실패/비완벽 trace를 지우고 남은 attempt로 다시 새긴다. Accept는 score>=70 segment를 잠그고 다음으로 진행한다.

## 4. Core Loop
Mission Brief → Preview → Pressure → Carve → Replay/Review → score>=70 Accept 또는 Correct → 모든 segment 복원 → Full Playback → Result → 다음 record/Retry.

## 5. Round / Session Structure
Mission은 ordered segment 3–6개. 각 segment attempts 3. Inspect→Carve Ready→Carving→Review. Valid carve는 attempt 1을 소비한다. score>=70이면 Accept 가능. score<70이고 attempts가 남으면 Correct. score<70이고 attempts=0이면 즉시 mission failure. 모든 segment Accept면 success. 평균 3–6분.

## 6. Game Rules
판정 좌표는 회전 화면이 아니라 segment local normalized space다. u=0 start, u=1 end; v는 authored centerline에 수직인 signed normalized offset이며 segment half-width=1. Drag path는 u 기준 32개 등간격 sample로 보간한다. Pressure는 attempt 동안 고정 integer 1–3. Duration은 valid start touch부터 valid end release까지 초 단위.

각 target은 32 target_v, target_pressure, target_duration_seconds를 가진다. Valid start/end zone radius는 0.12 segment-width units. Raw sample 사이 u가 0.08보다 크게 역행하면 invalid. End release는 end zone 안이며 authored arc의 80% 이상을 진행해야 한다. Invalid carve는 attempt를 소비하지 않는다.

shape_error=mean(abs(player_v-target_v)) clamped0..1. pressure_error=abs(player_pressure-target_pressure)/2. tempo_error=min(abs(player_duration-target_duration)/target_duration,1). score=round(100*(1-(0.65*shape_error+0.20*pressure_error+0.15*tempo_error))). Pass70, Perfect90.

Valid carve 완료 즉시 attempts_left-1. score<70이고 attempts_left=0이면 failure. Success는 모든 segment Accept. Success rating은 accepted segment score 평균: 1 star=success, 2>=80, 3>=90. Pause는 playback/timer를 정지한다. Carving 중 Pause는 미완성 carve를 무비용 취소하고 Carve Ready로 복귀한다. Retry는 mission-local trace/score/attempt/progress를 reset한다.

## 7. State Model
Mission Select→Mission Brief→Inspect→Carve Ready→Carving→Review. Review에서 Accept는 다음 Inspect, Retry는 Carve Ready, attempts0+fail은 Result. 마지막 Accept는 Full Playback→Result. Pause는 현재 상태를 보존하되 Carving만 무비용 cancel semantics를 가진다.

## 8. Interaction Spec
Preview tap/hold. Pressure vertical drag를 1/2/3으로 quantize. Carve는 single pointer; valid/invalid는 Game Rules 기준. Active carve가 pointer priority를 가진다. Review Accept는 score>=70, Retry는 attempts_left>0. Invalid action은 state change 없음.

## 9. Content Model
MVP 10 missions. Content classes: Clean Melody(기본), Wavering Voice(잦은 v 부호 변화), Pressure Phrase(target pressure 변화), Tempo Phrase(target duration 1.5–5.0s 변화), Composite Record(5–6 segments에서 세 축 결합). Mission topology는 ordered linear segments이며 이전 Accept 전 다음 segment는 열리지 않는다. Variation axes는 segment count, trace amplitude/frequency, pressure, duration, target complexity다. 모든 후반 content는 동일 state graph/interaction을 재사용한다.

## 10. Difficulty / Variation
1–2 Clean, 3–4 Wavering, 5–6 Pressure, 7–8 Tempo, 9–10 Composite. 난도는 랜덤/시간제한이 아니라 목표 궤적·pressure·duration 조합으로 증가한다.

## 11. Progression
Mission1 최초 해금. 성공 시 정확히 다음 mission 해금. mission별 best score와 best stars 저장. Stars는 판정 능력을 변경하지 않는다.

## 12. Economy
Not required. Attempts는 mission-local 기회이며 화폐가 아니다.

## 13. Screen Inventory
Record Shelf / Mission Select, Mission Brief, Record Carving Gameplay, Full Playback, Mission Result.

## 14. Screen Flow
Shelf→Brief→Inspect→Ready→Carving→Review. Accept→next segment, Correct→Ready, third failed valid attempt→failure Result. Last Accept→Full Playback→success Result. Next→next Brief, Retry→same mission reset, Shelf→select. Pause semantics는 section6과 동일.

## 15. Feedback System
Preview는 ghost hum/target trace. Carve는 groove와 cutting texture. Invalid는 scratch reject+no cost. Review는 mismatch region과 shape/pressure/tempo component를 보여준다. Accept는 restored segment. Full Playback은 assembled song. Failure는 failed segment에서 복원 중단을 명확히 전달한다.

## 16. Visual Direction Brief
Portrait mobile. 중심은 회전 record/current groove segment. finger path, target trace, start/end, pressure가 판독되어야 한다. 판정은 normalized local space로 결정론적이다. 어두운 공장과 제한된 ghost glow. 구체 UI 좌표는 Wireframe 책임이다.

## 17. MVP Scope
10 authored missions, 3–6 segments each, 5 content classes, 32-sample trace judging, pressure1–3, target duration1.5–5.0s, attempts3, pass70/perfect90, correction, Full Playback, stars, linear unlock, pause/retry/best score. NOT IN MVP: real audio analysis, microphone, freeform import, procedural targets, currency/shop, cosmetics, branching narrative, leaderboard, multi-touch carve.

## 18. Test Scenarios
shape_error0.10/pressure0/tempo0.10 valid carve는 score92로 pass. Valid carve만 attempt 소비. 세 번 sub70 valid carve로 3→2→1→0 failure. Carving Pause는 no-cost cancel. pressure target3/player1은 pressure weighted penalty20. 5 classes는 same state graph. Last Accept→Full Playback→success+next unlock. Retry는 mission-local reset, meta progress 보존.

## 19. Known Risks
Finger occlusion, scoring harshness, synthetic audio와 점수 체감 불일치, long trace touch jitter, authored target 다양성 생산 부담.

## 20. Wireframe Handoff
5 screen types와 Inspect/Ready/Carving/Review/Full Playback/Result/Pause를 표현한다. Target/player groove, start/end validity, pressure1–3, attempts3, component error/score, invalid no-cost reset, valid attempt consumption, Accept/Correct, 5 content variations, Carving pause cancel, third-fail Result, Full Playback, linear unlock/star variants를 전체 MVP 범위에서 표현한다.

accept.visual: segment becomes restored part of record

review.audio: player carve phrase compared with ghost target
review.visual: shape mismatch regions plus pressure/tempo component results

failure.visual: record restoration halts at failed segment

full_playback.visual: whole record spins with all restored grooves

round_structure: 한 mission은 3~6개의 authored groove segment로 구성된다. 각 segment는 Inspect → Carve Ready → Carving → Review → Accept/Correct 순서다. 기본 attempts는 segment당 3회이며 실패한 carve도 1회를 소비한다. 모든 segment를 score>=70으로 Accept하면 mission success. attempts가 0인데 score<70이면 mission failure. 평균 mission 3~6분.

carve.change: on valid completion attempts_left-1 and score computed
carve.priority: active carve owns pointer; all other gameplay input blocked

pause.change: freeze; Carving specifically cancels current uncommitted carve without cost

review.valid: accept requires score>=70; retry requires attempts_left>0

pressure.cancel: release outside control keeps previous level

core_player_verbs.state_change: no score change; target pattern audition/visual reference plays

core_player_verbs.input: drag along active arc from start marker to end marker
core_player_verbs.state_change: sampled groove trace stored; segment enters Review
no score change; target/player comparison playback runs
previous trace cleared; attempts_left-1; returns Carve Ready

core_player_verbs.feedback: segment seals and song reconstruction advances

wireframe_handoff: Represent all five screen types and Inspect/Carve Ready/Carving/Review/Full Playback/Result/Pause states.
Represent the normalized segment concept visually without exposing implementation coordinates as UI layout.
Show target trace, player groove, start/end validity, pressure1–3, attempts3, component errors and total score.
Show invalid carve as no-cost reset, valid carve as attempt consumption, pass Accept and failed Correct paths.
Show Clean/Wavering/Pressure/Tempo/Composite content variations without inventing new rules.
Show pause semantics including Carving cancel-without-cost, mission failure after third sub-70 valid attempt, final Full Playback and linear unlock/star Result variants.
primary_interaction: 압력 레벨을 선택하고 회전 레코드의 active arc를 start→end로 한 손가락 drag해 목표 홈 궤적을 재현
difficulty_variation: 초반 1–2는 Clean Melody로 start/end와 shape를 학습한다. 3–4는 Wavering Voice로 곡률 변화, 5–6은 Pressure Phrase로 깊이 선택, 7–8은 Tempo Phrase로 시간 정확도를 추가한다. 9–10은 Composite로 세 축을 동시에 요구한다. 제한시간 단축이나 랜덤 판정은 사용하지 않는다.
visual_direction_brief: Portrait mobile. 중심은 회전하는 레코드와 현재 groove segment이며 손가락 궤적, 목표 trace, start/end, 홈 깊이 상태가 작은 화면에서도 겹쳐 읽혀야 한다. 실제 판정은 회전 화면 좌표가 아니라 normalized segment local space를 사용해 결정론적으로 유지한다. 공장은 어둡고 유령의 파형은 제한된 발광 요소로 사용한다. Shelf/Brief/Result는 같은 음반 공장 세계를 유지하되 구체 좌표와 패널 배치는 Wireframe 책임이다.
